title: Notifier
lead: Send the scheduled pings via ntfy (stdlib `urllib`) and/or email (stdlib `smtplib`) (X1, X2).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A short reminder at the right time ("tacos tonight, defrost turkey") makes larder useful without anyone opening it.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None if the notifications interview is done.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. A pluggable Channel protocol (portability); ntfy and email implementations.
2. Scheduler jobs per ADR 0024; dedupe with a sent-log table.
3. Admin page to send a test ping.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; the owner and a non-technical household member each receive a test ping on their chosen channel.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
